paper_metadata.title: Novel as-cast HfNbTaTiAl refractory multi-principal element alloys with superior strength-ductility combination at room temperature

evidence.quote: In this work, we designed novel HfNbTaTiAl RMPEAs and studied the structure-properties relation and deformation mechanism at room temperature.
In this work, several as-cast RMPEAs with high strength and excellent ductility were designed based on AlxHfTaTi alloy by replacing Ta with Nb.
The Al9.0Hf30.3NbxTa30.3-xTi30.3 (x = 0,10,15 at.%) RMPEAs were prepared by vacuum arc melting using pure metals Al, Hf, Nb, Ta, Ti (purity higher than 99.9 wt%).
